mapper.select: SELECT appointment_id,appointment_date,appointment_time,status,name,department_name,title_name FROM appointments app,doctors doc, departments dep, professional_titles pt WHERE app.doctor_id=doc.doctor_id AND doc.department_id=dep.department_id AND doc.professional_title_id = pt.id
SELECT appointment_id,appointment_date,appointment_time,status,name FROM appointments app,patients pa WHERE app.patient_id=pa.patient_id

SELECT appointment_id, appointment_date, appointment_time, status,name, department_name, title_name FROM appointments app,doctors doc, departments dep, professional_titles pt WHERE app.patient_id = #{patientId} AND app.doctor_id=doc.doctor_id AND doc.department_id=dep.department_id AND doc.professional_title_id = pt.id

SELECT appointment_id, appointment_date,appointment_time, status,name, id_card_number, phone,balance FROM appointments app,patients pa WHERE app.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND app.patient_id=pa.patient_id
SELECT appointment_id, appointment_date, appointment_time, status,name FROM appointments app,doctors doc WHERE app.patient_id = #{patientId} AND app.doctor_id=doc.doctor_id
SELECT appointment_id, patient_id, doctor_id, appointment_date, appointment_time, status FROM appointments WHERE appointment_date = #{date} AND status = 'booked'
